exp = load("exp", clean=False)
rng = np.random.default_rng(73)
null_cond = rng.permutation(exp.cond.values)      # 집단 표시만 뒤섞는다
d = exp.copy(); d["cond"] = null_cond

dc = d[d.attn_1 == 1]                              # 사전에 정한 주 분석
print(round(float(stats.ttest_ind(dc[dc.cond == 1].mil,
                                  dc[dc.cond == 0].mil).pvalue), 3))
# 0.346

def 갈림길(df, cond):
    out = []
    d = df.copy(); d["cond"] = cond
    for oc in ("mil", "flr"):                                  # 결과 변수 2
        for excl in ("none", "attn", "trim"):                  # 표본 3
            e = d
            if excl == "attn":
                e = d[d.attn_1 == 1]
            elif excl == "trim":
                z = (d[oc] - d[oc].mean()) / d[oc].std(ddof=1)
                e = d[np.abs(z) <= 2.5]
            for sub in ("all", "m", "f", "young", "old"):      # 하위집단 5
                s = e
                if sub == "m":    s = e[e.gender == 1]
                elif sub == "f":  s = e[e.gender == 2]
                elif sub == "young": s = e[e.age <= e.age.median()]
                elif sub == "old":   s = e[e.age >  e.age.median()]
                for cov in (False, True):                      # 공변인 2
                    if cov:
                        _, _, p, _ = ols(s[oc], [s.cond, s.mil_t1])
                        out.append(p[1])
                    else:
                        out.append(stats.ttest_ind(s[s.cond == 1][oc],
                                                   s[s.cond == 0][oc]).pvalue)
    return out

ps = 갈림길(exp, null_cond)
print(len(ps), sum(p < .05 for p in ps), round(min(ps), 3))
# 60 10 0.02

rng = np.random.default_rng(37)
counts = [sum(p < .05 for p in 갈림길(exp, rng.permutation(exp.cond.values)))
          for _ in range(200)]
print(round(float(np.mean(counts)), 1), round(float(np.mean(np.array(counts) > 0)), 2))
# 3.1 0.53

from scipy import stats
g = np.random.default_rng(73)
n, K, R = 100, 5, 4000
raw = bon = 0
for _ in range(R):
    ps = [stats.ttest_ind(g.normal(0, 1, n), g.normal(0, 1, n)).pvalue
          for _ in range(K)]
    raw += any(p < .05 for p in ps)        # 보정 없음
    bon += any(p < .05 / K for p in ps)    # 문턱을 개수로 나눈다
print(round(raw / R, 3), round(bon / R, 3), round(1 - .95 ** K, 3))
# 0.235 0.047 0.226

g = np.random.default_rng(73)
raw = bon = 0
for _ in range(R):
    p = stats.ttest_ind(g.normal(0.4, 1, n), g.normal(0, 1, n)).pvalue
    raw += p < .05
    bon += p < .05 / K
print(round(raw / R, 3), round(bon / R, 3))
# 0.804 0.588
